brief.claim: Across critically ill patients, whole-body oxygen uptake measured by expired-gas analysis is positively correlated with systemic oxygen delivery (cardiac output times arterial oxygen content): the Pearson correlation is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: Cardiac output of each patient by thermodilution, in L/min.
Arterial blood oxygen content of each patient, in mL O2 per dL.
Mixed venous blood oxygen content of each patient, in mL O2 per dL.
Whole-body oxygen uptake of each patient from expired-gas analysis, in mL/min.

brief.sizes: patients = 60; cardiac_output, arterial_o2_content, venous_o2_content and o2_uptake_expired each have shape (60,).
